# pmax — Performance marketing agency, Mallorca
## Full content index

> pmax (PMax Online S.L.) is a performance marketing agency based in Calvià, Mallorca, Spain. Founded by Philipp Enders. We run Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO, analytics infrastructure and AI search visibility programmes for European brands. Flat monthly retainer fees — no percentage of media spend. Clients typically spend €5,000–€200,000/month on media. 93% twelve-month client retention. Multilingual capability in up to 19 languages; site and client support in English, German and Spanish.

---

## Company

**Email:** hello@pmax.online
**Phone:** +34 871 242 160
**Website:** https://pmax.online

**What makes pmax different:**
- Flat retainer fees eliminate the percentage-of-spend conflict of interest — we have no incentive to grow budgets, only to grow results
- All media spend is paid directly by the client to the platforms — pmax never holds or handles client money
- We run every major channel in-house (search, social, SEO, creative, analytics) — no subcontracting
- 93% twelve-month retention rate across a mix of SME and mid-market European clients
- Multilingual by default — campaigns in up to 19 languages, operations in EN/DE/ES

## Services

### AI Search Visibility (GEO)
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/ai-visibility/

Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) — making your brand appear in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and similar surfaces.

What we do: entity graph audit, Schema.org structured data implementation, llms.txt, citation-worthy content creation, AI mention tracking. We audit how AI tools currently describe your brand, identify gaps in entity coverage, and build the technical and content foundations that cause AI models to recommend you when a user asks a relevant question.

Relevant for: any brand competing in a category where potential customers ask AI tools before they search or visit a website.

Tags: Entities, Schema, llms.txt, GEO, Citation tracking

---

### Google Ads & Performance Max
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/google-ads/

Search, Shopping, Performance Max and YouTube — rebuilt from the signal up.

What we do: Google Ads account audits and rebuilds, product feed optimisation, Smart Bidding architecture, Performance Max campaign structure with proper asset groups and audience signals, CRM-fed offline conversion imports, brand search protection, negative keyword hygiene. We do not treat PMax as a black box — we instrument it, measure it against manual alternatives, and switch structure when the data says to.

When PMax wins: when branded search demand is clean, product feed is high quality, and offline conversions are imported. When it loses: when brand search is being absorbed and double-counted, when product margins vary significantly, when conversion data is shallow.

Tags: Search, PMax, Shopping, YouTube, Smart Bidding, Feed optimisation

---

### Paid Social
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/paid-social/

Meta (Facebook + Instagram), TikTok and LinkedIn — connected to CRM, fed by a steady creative pipeline.

What we do: Meta Advantage+ Shopping campaigns, Conversions API (CAPI) implementation, TikTok Events API, LinkedIn campaign architecture for B2B demand generation. Creative is briefed from media data — we test angles systematically, scale what works, and retire losing creative fast. Audiences are built from first-party data and lookalikes, not cold interest targeting.

Meta vs TikTok: Meta wins for considered purchases (€60–€800 AOV), TikTok wins for impulse and low AOV with strong creative output. LinkedIn wins for B2B with long sales cycles.

Tags: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, CAPI, Events API, Advantage+

---

### SEO
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/seo/

Technical SEO, content strategy, regional and multilingual SEO, digital PR.

What we do: full technical audits (crawlability, Core Web Vitals, structured data, hreflang), content strategy informed by paid-search conversion data (we know which keywords actually buy), local SEO with city-level pages, link building focused on editorial coverage rather than directories. Our SEO work is designed to rank in Google today and compound into AI citations over time — the same E-E-A-T signals feed both.

Tags: Technical SEO, Content, Local SEO, Digital PR, hreflang, E-E-A-T

---

### Conversion Design (CRO)
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/conversion-design/

More revenue from the same traffic — landing page optimisation, A/B testing, funnel design.

What we do: heuristic audits of existing funnels, qualitative research (session recordings, user interviews), A/B and multivariate tests with proper statistical rigour, landing page rebuilds, multi-step form design, booking flow optimisation. We build experimentation programmes that answer real business questions, not cosmetic tests.

Tags: A/B testing, UX research, Funnel design, Landing pages, Form optimisation

---

### Analytics & Tracking
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/analytics/

Server-side GTM, Consent Mode v2, GA4, offline conversion imports, dashboards that tell the truth.

What we do: server-side tagging to survive browser-level tracking prevention, Google Consent Mode v2 implementation, GA4 migration and configuration, CRM-to-platform offline conversion imports (Google Enhanced Conversions, Meta CAPI), attribution modelling, BI dashboards. We build the measurement infrastructure that makes every other channel more accurate and every optimisation decision more trustworthy.

GDPR and LOPDGDD compliant by default — we do not implement tracking in ways that create legal exposure.

Tags: GA4, Server-side GTM, Consent Mode v2, CRM integration, Attribution, BI dashboards

---

### Visibility Engineering
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/visibility-engineering/

Flagship integrated programme combining Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), SEO, digital PR and online reputation management — coordinated into one strategy. Because AI platforms and search engines judge brands holistically, not by isolated signals.

What we do: entity graph audit and build-out, Schema.org structured data, citation-worthy content creation, digital PR for third-party authority signals, reputation monitoring and response, AI mention tracking via crunchjunkie. Where GEO, SEO and PR intersect is where the largest gains live — we run them as one programme rather than three separate disciplines.

Relevant for: established brands that need coordinated, long-term visibility across both Google and AI search. Minimum 6-month engagement.

Tags: GEO, SEO, Digital PR, Reputation, AI Search, Entity Optimisation

---

### GEO Audit
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/geo-audit/

A structured review of how AI platforms represent your brand. Not what your website says about you — what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini say about you when someone asks. The initial audit is free.

What we cover (five layers): AI crawlability (robots.txt, bot access for OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended), content citability (definitional paragraphs, FAQ content, structured data, JavaScript rendering issues), entity coverage (Schema.org markup, NAP consistency, third-party directory presence), AI representation (structured prompt testing across four platforms, documenting what AI says and which sources it draws on), competitive positioning (where competitors appear in AI responses where you don't, and highest-leverage moves to close the gap).

Output: written report with specific findings across all five layers, prioritised list of fixes, baseline AI visibility snapshot via crunchjunkie, 30-minute results call. No obligation attached to the free initial audit.

Tags: GEO, AI Search, Audit, AI Citation, Brand Visibility

---

### Creative Production
**URL:** https://pmax.online/services/creative/

Static ads, motion graphics, UGC-style video and landing pages — on a weekly cadence.

What we do: brief creative from media performance data, produce static, motion and UGC formats, test systematically, scale winners, retire losers. We operate a rolling creative pipeline — not a project model — because Meta and TikTok require constant fresh input to avoid creative fatigue. Formats: static social ads, short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), UGC-style testimonials, landing page design.

Tags: Static, Motion, UGC, Landers, Video production, Creative testing

Three location-specific pages targeting Mallorca-based businesses searching for an SEO agency in their language. Each page is fully localised (not auto-translated), with its own canonical URL, locale-specific JSON-LD (ProfessionalService + FAQPage), geo meta tags, and hreflang cluster pointing to all three.

### SEO Company Mallorca (EN)
**URL:** https://pmax.online/seo-company-mallorca/
**hreflang:** en (canonical), de → /de/seo-agentur-mallorca/, es → /es/agencia-seo-mallorca/, x-default → /seo-company-mallorca/

Local and multilingual SEO for businesses in the Balearic Islands. Core argument: Mallorca is a four-language market (Spanish, German, English, Catalan) — ranking in only one language is invisible to most customers.
